source.title: Supplementary Information - Database of diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS) and hyperspectral imaging (HSI) spectra of pigments and dyes for historical document analysis

preparation.binder_solution: 20 g gum per 100 mL water (20:100 w/v)
preparation.mixture_unit: Volume of prepared paint stock; not dry-pigment mass
preparation.midpoint: 0.25 mL colored paint stock mixed with 0.25 mL lead-white stock
preparation.stock_yield: Not reported; grams per millilitre of finished stock cannot be derived exactly.
preparation.illumination: Four halogen lamps oriented to avoid specular reflection; 90% reflectance reference
preparation.instrument: Resonon Pika L, 2.1 nm spectral resolution, 50 cm capture distance
preparation.sampling: Published interpolation at 5 nm over 400–1000 nm
preparation.measurement: Mean of 20 by 20 pixel region; population standard deviations recomputed from distributed float32 ROI cube.

limitations: Yellow ochre has no measured white mixture and is pure-only.
No egg-yolk or opaque-ground calibration. These are gum-Arabic paint films on parchment.
No absorption/scattering coefficients, controlled film thickness, density or opacity measurements.
Interior interpolation is a bounded empirical estimate, not an independently validated pigment-mixing law.
The supplementary preparation text has erroneous specimen-number cross-references (e.g. grape-seed black n.29); identity follows explicit name and primary sample table.
400-pixel spatial spread is not replicate-batch uncertainty or historical-material variability.
Do not mix superimposed-layer specimens into homogeneous-mixture families.

The separately tabulated CIELAB spreadsheet does not numerically agree with simple D65 integration of the distributed mean curves: selected pure stocks differ by approximately 1.6–7.0 DeltaE76. Keep spectra authoritative for this implementation; do not claim that discrepancy resolved.

Measured LTY-white midpoint is slightly darker than pure LTY; measured grape-seed black paint is a medium gray. Do not force monotonic lightness or treat specimen appearance as universal pigment reflectance.

cie.creator: International Commission on Illumination (CIE)
cie.changes: Selected 400–780 nm in 5 nm steps. Pigment spectra also truncated to these bands.
